about: Kerner Law Group holds four verified offices, three in the Bronx and one in Yonkers, and publishes five attorneys on its legal team page: Stuart M. Kerner, Matthew H. Kerner, Craig Dietsch, Christopher L. Esposito and John Grill.

545 reviews across those four listings, every one of them at 5.0. Contingency fees, a free consultation, a 24 hour line and pages in Spanish, published. It prints settlement figures on that same team page and publishes no case results page we could read as a list.
